newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open flat to up 0.10 cent.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open flat to up 0.10 cent.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open unchanged to 0.10 cent firmer Wednesday, based on market orders at 1020 EDT, dealers said.
Resistance was pegged at 74.10 cents a lb for July delivery, where buy stops are expected to be resting.
"Unless July breaks 74.10, we'll probably stay rangebound. The trade will keep it in check," a floor source said.
A lack of fundamental news is contributing to the market's sideways pattern, analysts said.
Tuesday, July cotton settled 0.06 cent higher at 73.42 cents, traded 73.65 to 72.90 cents. New-crop December went out 0.03 cent firmer at 75.76 cents, in volume estimated at a light 8,000 lots.
